entries.source_jp:
魔道剣で敵の魔力を我が物とする魔法剣士
魔力を攻守に長けた魔法へと変化させ
様々な状況で戦況を覆す事で輝きを放つ
entries.source_en:
A magickal swordfighter who uses their sword to take
their enemy's magick into their own hands.
Transforms magickal power into
offensive and defensive effects.
Shines by overturning the battle situation in
various situations.
entries.text:
Entzieht Gegnern mit dem magischen
Schwert ihre Magie. Wandelt sie in
Angriffs- und Schutzzauber um.
